Author: NearVoice contributors; original by Ricimon
Name: NearVoice
Description: Automatic world/map proximity, quiet connection/map changes, bounded audio buffers, Turkish font and optional talking animation. 0.2.2 disables old default join/leave beeps once while preserving microphone and other settings. /yakin opens the panel.

Author: XeldarAlz; local Discord adaptation

Description: Private local edition based on Aetherphone. Uses official Discord authorization for contacts and text chat. Aethernet services and unchecked native media/browser playback are disabled.

Author: SmolShar; original It's Up by Juan Medina
Name: It's Up Combo
Description: Shows Samurai's native PvE combo branches and Sage's core spells using actions placed on your hotbars. Ready cooldown reminders appear before the first use and outside combat. A separate resource/proc panel shows eligible Samurai Kenki, Sen, Meditation and follow-up actions, plus Sage Addersgall and Addersting spenders. Real hotbar key labels appear below icons. Three framed panels move and resize independently and remain visible with the game HUD hidden. Gentle transitions preserve press feedback; finishers have no false link back to the starter. Use /itsupcombo for settings or /itsupcombo move to arrange the panels. This plugin only displays information and never executes actions. Core and resource panels currently support Samurai and Sage; other jobs retain configurable cooldown reminders.
Punchline: Compact Samurai and Sage HUD with combo, resource and cooldown panels.
Changelog: Üç ayrı panel, hotbara yerleştirilmiş eylemler, hazır kaynak/proc göstergeleri ve tuş ipuçları. Canlı oyun kabul testi henüz yapılmadı. https://github.com/SmolShar/NearVoice-Downloads/releases/tag/its-up-combo-0.1.1-2026-10-24
